title: Sauce Ravigote with Gently Poached Cod
summary: Delicately poached cod served with a fresh, piquant dressing of chopped tomato, capers, onion and herbs.
equipment: wide stainless steel saucepan or sauté pan

ingredients.item: plum tomatoes, seeded and finely diced
onion, finely chopped, rinsed and drained
garlic cloves, crushed and finely chopped
fine sea salt or table salt
skinless cod fillets, about 150 g each and 3 cm thick

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Combine the tomatoes, capers, spring onions, rinsed onion, garlic, parsley, salt, pepper, olive oil and lemon juice in a bowl and leave at room temperature.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Bring 1000 ml water to the boil in a wide pan.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Lower in the cod fillets, return to the boil for about 2 min, then take off the heat.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Leave the fish in the hot water until it flakes and reaches 63 °C in the centre, 5-7 min depending on thickness.

steps.title: Drain
steps.text: Lift out the cod with a fish slice, drain well and set on warm plates.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the ravigote over and around the fish and serve at once.

tips: Make the ravigote ahead and let it sit at room temperature while the fish cooks, so the flavours have time to meld.
Take the pan off the heat as soon as it returns to the boil; the fish finishes cooking gently in the hot water.
Check the fish is cooked through to the centre before lifting it out, as thickness will affect the exact timing.
storage: This dish is best served immediately while the fish is warm and the ravigote is fresh. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
